title: Stability of the Monomial Basis Kernel of Reinhardt domains
summary: On a pseudoconvex Reinhardt domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{C}^n$ the $p$-Bergman space $A^p(Ω)$ admits a canonical basis of monomials indexed by a subset $S_p(Ω)\subset\mathbb{Z}^n$. The corresponding $p$-Monomial Basis Kernel (or $p$-MBK) is defined by a series involving these monomials and their norms. This article records stability properties of the $p$-MBK and of the index set $S_p(Ω)$ with respect to the parameter $p$.
